text:
Aisha Khan: Quick announcement: Deterministic Tool-Calling (v1) is GA for Hosted API as of 10:00 PT. This feature makes tool-call ordering and retries deterministic across retries/failovers for supported tool adapters. Rolling enablement starts now.

Tom Reed: Does this change payloads or require SDK upgrades?

Aisha Khan: No payload change for most users. We added a deterministic_id header and a new 'deterministic' flag in the call config. SDKs have opt-in helpers; see short sample below.

DevEx Bot: JS sample (redwood-js@1.0.0):
```js
client.callTool('search', { q: 'latest metrics' }, { deterministic: true, deterministicId: 'abc-123' })
```

OpsBot: rollout: canary us-west 2% -> 10% (1999991300) :rocket:

Lina Park: Billing impact?

Aisha Khan: No direct surcharge. Deterministic mode uses idempotent routing and small extra metadata. Watch for marginal latency change on p95 in dashboards.

Evan Cho: Rollback triggers?

Aisha Khan: Rollback triggers: incorrect tool-output consistency violations >0.1% over 30m or error spike >3% over 5m. Rollback path: disable deterministic routing feature-flag -> traffic returns to best-effort tool-calling. Ops owns the kill switch.

ProductAnnouncerBot: Docs & runbook: https://redwood.internal/docs/deterministic-toolcall, https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deterministic-toolcall

Aisha Khan: Action items: SDK owners please verify client helpers by EOD tomorrow. Oncall, check the new dashboards under Observability -> Tool-Calling -> Deterministic. Ping me for staging keys. :thumbsup:
